lines.text: A person who stays up late.
I'm a night owl, so I study late.

data.mean: A person who stays up late.
data.define: Someone who likes being awake at night.

example.text: I'm a night owl, so I study late.

misuse.text: Don't call a morning person a 'night owl'.
misuse.why: It means someone who stays up late.
